task: pick up the tomato sauce and place it in the basket

windows.text: Hold the open gripper stationary above the table, positioned over the tomato sauce bottle.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the tomato sauce bottle.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the tomato sauce bottle.
Approach the tomato sauce bottle from above, lowering the open gripper around its neck.
Approach the tomato sauce bottle from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Approach the tomato sauce can from above, lowering the open gripper around its sides.
Grasp the tomato sauce can by closing the gripper fingers around its sides.
Lift the tomato sauce can vertically off the floor, raising it above the surrounding objects.
Lift the tomato sauce can upward off the table, moving it away from the other containers.
Carry the tomato sauce can horizontally across the table toward the basket.
Carry the tomato sauce can horizontally toward the basket.
Carry the tomato sauce can over the basket.
Release the tomato sauce into the basket.
Release the tomato sauce into the basket and open the gripper.
Retract the open gripper upward and away from the basket.
